hypotheses.B1_rank4_survives_random_sites: For natural output queries on random sites, rank-4 finite-effect fidelity is at least 0.95 on both corpora.
hypotheses.B2_rank4_survives_random_readouts: For random output readouts on random sites, rank-4 finite-effect fidelity is at least 0.95 on both corpora.
hypotheses.B3_rank16_is_universally_near_exact: Rank-16 fidelity is at least 0.99 for both query families and corpora.
hypotheses.B4_high_score_selection_is_not_required: Natural-query random-site rank-4 fidelity is within 0.05 of the prior high-score panel on both corpora.
hypotheses.B5_random_readouts_have_similar_gram_com: Rank-4 Gram energy differs by at most 0.10 between natural and random readouts on both corpora.
